news.title: Vance is among 1.5% of Americans who have converted to Catholicism
news.summary_en: Converts make up 8% of U.S. Catholics. The remaining 92% of U.S. Catholics were raised in the faith and still identify with it today.

news.title: Americans say keeping up with key news topics is crucial. But fewer say they’re highly informed themselves
news.summary_en: Democrats and Republicans broadly show similar patterns in how they evaluate the importance of staying informed about various topics.

news.title: Most people across 36 countries have negative views of Israel and little confidence in Netanyahu
news.summary_en: Majorities in most of the countries we surveyed express an unfavorable view of Israel and little or no confidence in Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
